title: What Solar Paint Systems Is
definition: Solar Paint Systems: paint that turns any surface into a solar panel.
description:
Solar Paint Systems — Signature Edition: paint that turns any surface into a solar panel. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature paint hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: PV pigments rethought, paint logistics rebuilt, spray application reimagined for the century ahead. t: The Signature Vision: Solar Paint Systems
title: The Signature Vision: Solar Paint Systems
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Solar Paint Systems.
description:
The Signature vision of Solar Paint Systems does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature paint hulls program, charter one: master PV pigments at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale paint logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate spray application systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Solar Paint Systems becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

t: 2032 — First commercial paint hulls plant sells PV pigments power to th
title: 2032 — First commercial paint hulls plant sells PV pigments power to th
definition: 2032 milestone on the Solar Paint Systems roadmap.
description:
First commercial paint hulls plant sells PV pigments power to the grid under a 20-year durability testing contract.

What must be true first: the PV pigments results have to replicate outside the lab, paint logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and spray application operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed PV pigments demonstrations, paint logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting spray application uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Solar Paint Systems
definition: Estimates Solar Paint Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Solar Paint Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a paint hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Solar Paint Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Solar Paint Systems operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Solar Paint Systems installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 35354 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where PV pigments monitoring, paint logistics redundancy, or spray application maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Solar Paint Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Solar Paint Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Solar Paint Systems — paint that turns any surface into a solar panel.

Phase 1 — Prove (PV pigments): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (paint logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (spray application): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (durability testing): paint hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and buildings-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
